meta.title: Health Quote
meta.description: Instant quotations for a health insurance product. The rating tables, the pricing definitions, the endpoints and the pages are one document; the browser prices the quote live and the server prices it again with the very same definitions before storing it.

quotes.description: Every quotation issued. The stored pricing is the server's, computed under the document version recorded in `quotedUnder`.

plans.name: Plans
plans.description: Monthly base premium in cents for a 26 to 35 year old with no risk factors and no dependents.

age-bands.name: Age bands
age-bands.description: Multiplier by age. First matching row wins; an age outside every band is not insurable and falls back to `default`.

risk-factors.name: Behavior factors
risk-factors.description: Every row whose `match` fits the applicant applies (`collect`); the factors multiply. No row matching means no surcharge and no discount.

data.label: Regular
data.description: Sports two or more times a week

name.message: Tell us your name (2 to 60 characters).

email.message: We need a valid email to send the quote.

age.message: Age must be a whole number between 0 and 120.

create-quote.description: Issue a quote. The body is validated with the `applicant` schema, staged under `applicant` (the state path the browser uses) and priced with the same definitions the page shows live. The stored pricing is the server's word.

find-quotes.description: Quotes issued to one email, newest first.

accept-quote.description: Turn an open quote into a policy request. Refused when the quote was priced under another document version: the rates may have changed, ask for a fresh quote.

then.message: Our rates changed since this quote was issued. Please ask for a new one.

rating-tables.description: The tables the price comes from, as data. What you see is what is charged.

quote-stats.description: Aggregates over every quote. Nothing personal leaves the storage.

ageBand.description: Row of the age-bands table for the applicant, or the default row when the age is not insurable.

eligible.description: Only ages inside a band can be quoted.

riskRows.description: Every behavior factor that applies to the applicant.

riskFactor.description: Product of the applicable behavior factors.

planQuotes.description: Every plan priced for this applicant. The formula lives here once; `monthly` picks the chosen plan.

perPayment.description: What one payment costs under the chosen billing.

pricing.description: The whole breakdown as one value: shown live, stored with the quote, returned by the server.
